calcStep1NisabBody: Zakat is due if your net wealth exceeds the threshold. Nisab is based on 85g of platform 24k gold price.
calcStep1LivestockBody: Livestock Zakat is calculated by physical head-count scales (not % of value).
calcStep1LivestockNisabNote: Nisab thresholds: Sheep/Goats 40, Cattle 30, Camels 5. Cattle uses 30/40 combinations; camels follow tier ranges.
calcStep1CropBody: Crop Zakat is due at harvest. Nisab is 653kg. Rate is 10% (rain-fed), 5% (irrigated), or weighted for mixed.
calcLivestockTermsFootnote: Terms like tabi', musinnah, bint makhad, bint labun, hiqqah, and jadhah are explained below in Livestock details.
calcStep2EnterAssetsBody: Enter the value of your assets in ETB
calcPastureFedSubtitle: Advisory only; does not block calculation
calcHawlSubtitle: Advisory only; does not block calculation
calcWorkAnimalsSubtitle: Advisory only; does not block calculation
calcHowCropZakatWorksBody: Nisab: 653kg. Rates: rain-fed 10%, irrigated 5%, mixed = weighted split. Zakat is due at harvest (no annual hawl for crops).
calcHowCropZakatNote: Note: App applies these rules broadly for simplicity. Scholarly positions differ on crop-type scope and expense deductions; consult qualified scholars for specific cases.
calcWealthZakatDueLine: Wealth Zakat due (smaller amount on the card): {due}
calcHowWealthZakatWorksBody: We add cash on hand, bank balances, mobile wallets, business assets, and the value of gold and silver. Nisab is {grams} g of gold at the app’s 24k price per gram. Gold you hold is valued using the app’s rate for the karat you choose. Silver uses a fixed reference of {silverRate} ETB per gram. Liabilities you enter are subtracted to get net wealth. If net wealth is at or above nisab, Zakat due is 2.5% of net wealth.
calcHowWealthZakatNote: Note: Scholars differ on which assets are zakatable, how debts discount wealth, when the lunar year (hawl) applies, and other details. This screen is an educational estimate—confirm your situation with qualified scholars.
calcWealthBreakdownTitle: How the amounts above are calculated
calcWealthTransNetLine: Net wealth (large amount on the card): total assets − liabilities ({liabilities}) = {net}
calcWealthTransDueAbove: Because {net} is at or above nisab ({nisab}), Zakat due = {net} × 2.5% = {due}.
calcWealthTransDueBelow: Because {net} is below nisab ({nisab}), wealth Zakat due = {due}.
calcPayBlockedWealth: No wealth Zakat is due (below nisab or zero ETB due). Adjust your inputs.
calcPayBlockedLivestock: No livestock Zakat is due for your current counts.
calcPayBlockedCrops: Crop Zakat is not due yet (below harvest nisab or zero kg due).
calcLsNone: No livestock due under current counts
calcTransCattle: Cattle threshold: {head} >= 30 => due {tabi} tabi', {musinnah} musinnah (30/40 combination).
calcAdvNotPasture: Not pasture-fed most of the year: check trade/business treatment with scholars.
calcAdvHawl: Hawl not completed: many scholars require one lunar year for livestock zakat.
calcAdvWork: Work animals are typically exempt from livestock zakat.
calcCropTransBelow: Harvest {kg}kg is below Nisab ({nisab} kg), so no crop Zakat is due.
calcCropTransMixed: Mixed irrigation: rain {rain}%, irrigated {irrig}%. Effective rate = {rate}%. Formula: {kg} × {rate2}% = {due}kg.
